title: Spyglass: Officially Launched and Ready to Empower You
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, our cutting-edge new tool designed to provide unprecedented clarity and drive smarter decision-making across your business.

title: Empowered File and Image Management
summary: Gain powerful control over your images and files directly within the editor, with intuitive new options to manage, customize, and display your content exactly how you want.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a brand new public roadmap page, making it easier than ever to see what we've shipped, what's coming next, and what's planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a seamless task management experience with our enhanced checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and perfectly integrated with your workspace.

title: Enhanced Real-Time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly enhanced the collaborative editing experience, empowering teams to work together more intuitively and seamlessly in real-time.

title: Seamless Shared Item Access
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and utilize shared items, fostering seamless collaboration with your network.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko will soon support a wide array of international languages, allowing users worldwide to enjoy our platform in their native tongue.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to open source Noeko's codebase, inviting our community to gain maximum control, direct involvement, and full transparency in shaping the future of the project.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge Base with Advanced Filtering
summary: Transform your Constellation view into a dynamic knowledge exploration tool with powerful new filters and integrated social connections, making it easier than ever to discover insights and kickstart your workflows.

title: Precision Search & Curated Collections
summary: Experience a breakthrough in knowledge discovery as you apply sophisticated filters to pinpoint exact information and effortlessly transform your tailored searches into custom, savable collections.

title: Dynamic Note Views
summary: Discover a revolutionary way to organize your thoughts with new, versatile display modes for linked content, making your notes more interactive and intuitive.

title: Noeko Self-Hosted and Premium Editions
summary: We are excited to introduce versatile self-hosting options and powerful premium plans, giving you more control over your deployment and access to enhanced features.

title: New & Improved Visual Themes
summary: We're enhancing our current themes and introducing a diverse array of new visual styles to give your experience a fresh, personalized look.

title: Enhanced Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your greetings are always perfectly timed, providing a seamless and delightful experience every time you log in.

title: Effortless Tag Editing
summary: Now you can quickly remove and manage multiple items directly from a tag's view, making your organization faster and more intuitive.

title: Connect All Your Content
summary: Seamlessly bring a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, into your workspace for comprehensive organization and enhanced understanding.
